dlg.ch01.p01.a.s1: If it is stamped RECEIVED, it was received. That is how paper works.
dlg.ch01.p01.b.s1: Section 7: a witness may receive documents on behalf of the recipient.
dlg.ch01.p01.b.s2: A witness? I have never witnessed anything in my life. Where do I sign?
dlg.ch01.p01.fail: The rule did not even notice that. Try something with official ink.
dlg.ch01.p01.hint1: You cannot receive it once fired. Could it be received before, or by someone else?
dlg.ch01.p01.hint2: Look at the stamp tray and the staff manual.
dlg.ch01.p01.hint3: Stamp the notice, or show the manual to Director Vượng.
dlg.ch01.p01.success.a: That should not work. The stamp says it works. I hate that it works.
dlg.ch01.p01.success.b: Received on your behalf, by me. I feel strangely responsible.
dlg.ch01.p02.a.s1: A lost badge is deactivated automatically. I just need to lose it. On paper.
dlg.ch01.p02.a.s2: BADGE REPORTED LOST. DEACTIVATING. Please hand the lost badge to security.
dlg.ch01.p02.b.s1: If my badge is a visitor pass, I can return it to my host.
dlg.ch01.p02.b.s2: I am your host? I suppose I did invite you here. Eleven years ago.
dlg.ch01.p02.fail: BADGE STILL ACTIVE. Your attempt has been logged and ignored.
dlg.ch01.p02.hint1: An active badge cannot be handed in. What kind of badge could be?
dlg.ch01.p02.hint2: The lost & found tray and the visitor stickers both change what a badge is.
dlg.ch01.p02.hint3: File a lost form at the reader, or give a visitor sticker to your host.
dlg.ch01.p02.success.a: You have lost your badge while holding it. Security will find this fascinating.
dlg.ch01.p02.success.b: Thank you for visiting our company. Please do not visit again.
dlg.ch01.p03.a.s1: There is a marker. Meetings end when their agenda ends.
dlg.ch01.p03.a.s2: Item 1: Tí's farewell. Item 2: everyone goes home.
dlg.ch01.p03.b.s1: The sensor counts chairs, not people. Room B is free.
dlg.ch01.p03.b.s2: The chair rolls away with great dignity toward Room B.
dlg.ch01.p03.fail: Please sit down. We are discussing whether to discuss it.
dlg.ch01.p03.hint1: Either the meeting ends, or the system stops counting you.
dlg.ch01.p03.hint2: The agenda board and the room schedule matter.
dlg.ch01.p03.hint3: Write on the agenda, or book Room B for your chair.
dlg.ch01.p03.success.a: Agenda complete! Meeting adjourned! Everyone, applaud Tí, then leave.
dlg.ch01.p03.success.b: ATTENDEE RELOCATED TO ROOM B. Meeting continues without you. Thank you.
dlg.ch01.p04.a.s1: Complaints are pre-approved. I will complain about not being able to leave.
dlg.ch01.p04.a.s2: APPROVED COMPLAINT DETECTED. Printing: request to leave. Have a nice day.
dlg.ch01.p04.b.s1: I have a template approved for "anything". Please never tell LOGIC.
dlg.ch01.p04.b.s2: APPROVED. Content: anything. Printing anything: your exit request.
dlg.ch01.p04.fail: NOT APPROVED. Error 418: I am a printer, not a miracle.
dlg.ch01.p04.hint1: The printer needs something already approved.
dlg.ch01.p04.hint2: Check the complaint box, or ask Bốp.
dlg.ch01.p04.hint3: Feed the printer a complaint form or Bốp's template.
dlg.ch01.p04.success.a: You complained your way out. Very Vietnamese, very efficient.
dlg.ch01.p04.success.b: We are now co-conspirators. I have updated my threat model.
dlg.ch01.p05.a.s1: Thirty years of loyalty, hanging behind a trash can.
dlg.ch01.p05.a.s2: My plaque! Take my seniority, son. I only use it to find mops.
dlg.ch01.p05.b.s1: The elevator loves executives. What if executives lived downstairs?
dlg.ch01.p05.b.s2: EXECUTIVE FLOOR REQUESTED. Descending at prestige speed.
dlg.ch01.p05.hint1: You are not senior. Who is? Or which floor is?
dlg.ch01.p05.hint2: The dusty plaque and the label maker.
dlg.ch01.p05.hint3: Return the plaque to Tư, or label the floor panel.
dlg.ch01.p05.success.a: MOST SENIOR EMPLOYEE DETECTED. Elevator arriving. Please mind your status.
dlg.ch01.p05.success.b: The elevator came down? In thirty-one years it never came down for me.
dlg.ch01.p06.a.s1: Approved alarms are allowed. Noise is only illegal if it is unofficial.
dlg.ch01.p06.a.s2: SQUEEEAK. Every squeak is now a certified emergency.
dlg.ch01.p06.b.s1: A silence permit needs an authority. Bốp, are you an authority?
dlg.ch01.p06.b.s2: By my authority as a cube, these shoes are silent by definition.
dlg.ch01.p06.fail: NOISE DETECTED. Please stop existing so audibly.
dlg.ch01.p06.hint1: Noise is banned unless it is official.
dlg.ch01.p06.hint2: The alarm notice and the permit kiosk.
dlg.ch01.p06.hint3: Tag the cart as an alarm, or have Bốp approve a silence permit.
dlg.ch01.p06.success.a: You crossed the corridor as an alarm. Security will hear about this. Loudly.
dlg.ch01.p06.success.b: SQUEAK RECLASSIFIED AS SILENCE. Proceed quietly, loudly.
dlg.ch01.p07.a.s1: He needs an inspector. The mirror has one in it.
dlg.ch01.p07.a.s2: Who is that inspector? He looks very thorough. Inspect me, sir. Yes. Passed.
dlg.ch01.p07.b.s1: Form 12-B. Somebody had to invent it. Today it is my best friend.
dlg.ch01.p07.b.s2: Self-inspection? There is a form for that? I feel seen. Officially.
dlg.ch01.p07.fail: That is not on the checklist. Nothing is on the checklist except the checklist.
dlg.ch01.p07.hint1: Cộc needs to be inspected before he can inspect you.
dlg.ch01.p07.hint2: The checklist, the mirror, the form rack.
dlg.ch01.p07.hint3: Show the checklist to the mirror, or give Cộc Form 12-B.
dlg.ch01.p07.success.a: I have been inspected by myself. I am now qualified to inspect you. Passed.
dlg.ch01.p07.success.b: Form 12-B complete. You are polite. I will remember politeness.
dlg.ch01.p08.a.s1: The ledger is the truth. The key is just metal.
dlg.ch01.p08.a.s2: "Key 47: returned (yesterday)." The ink dries instantly, out of respect.
dlg.ch01.p08.b.s1: Keys can only be given to an appointed custodian. Here is the appointment form.
dlg.ch01.p08.b.s2: The drawer accepts the appointment, and the key, without a word.
dlg.ch01.p08.fail: Key returns are not accepted here. Or anywhere. Please return it there.
dlg.ch01.p08.hint1: You cannot hand in the key. Can the records do it for you?
dlg.ch01.p08.hint2: The key ledger, or ask Cộc who may accept keys.
dlg.ch01.p08.hint3: Write in the ledger with its pen, or appoint the empty drawer.
dlg.ch01.p08.success.a: The ledger says you returned it yesterday. Then why are you holding it? Never mind. Ledger wins.
dlg.ch01.p08.success.b: A drawer custodian. It has never been late. I respect that drawer.
dlg.ch01.p09.a.s1: An audit needs a subject. Write any subject. I am not creative.
dlg.ch01.p09.a.s2: AUDIT SUBJECT: EXIT DOOR. Door is compliant. Door may exit. Door opens.
dlg.ch01.p09.b.s1: In a drill, everyone must exit. Even auditors. Even me.
dlg.ch01.p09.b.s2: DRILL! Everyone out! By regulation! No audits during drills!
dlg.ch01.p09.fail: AUDIT INCOMPLETE. EXIT DENIED. Have you considered staying forever?
dlg.ch01.p09.hint1: The audit blocks the door. What if the door is the audit? Or nobody needs an audit?
dlg.ch01.p09.hint2: Ask Cộc about audits, or look at the fire alarm.
dlg.ch01.p09.hint3: Audit the door with Cộc's form, or start a drill and tell Cộc.
dlg.ch01.p09.success.a: You audited a door until it gave up. I am proud and slightly afraid.
dlg.ch01.p09.success.b: Drill complete. Everybody is outside. Including the person I was supposed to stop.
dlg.ch02.p01.a.s1: A witness must exist to witness. So if I witness myself, both of us exist.
dlg.ch02.p01.a.s2: Witness and subject are the same man. The form never forbids it. I will countersign.
dlg.ch02.p01.b.s1: A reversal restores your previous name. The roster cannot refuse a name it once had.
dlg.ch02.p01.b.s2: NAME CHANGE REVERSED. Restoring previous name: Tí. Previous record: not found. Restoring anyway.
dlg.ch02.p01.fail: APPLICANT NOT FOUND. Please register to become findable.
dlg.ch02.p01.hint1: You must exist to register. Can someone vouch for you, or can your name already be on record?
dlg.ch02.p01.hint2: Look at the witness statements and the name correction box.
dlg.ch02.p01.hint3: Give Lan a witness statement, or put a reversal form into the roster.
dlg.ch02.p01.success.a: Listed on the testimony of the only witness who was definitely present. You.
dlg.ch02.p01.success.b: You reversed a name change you never made. The roster believed you. That worries me.
dlg.ch02.p02.a.s1: Cộc manages the queue but is not in it. Nobody queues for the queue managers.
dlg.ch02.p02.a.s2: A queue for queue managers. I am its first member. You are second. Take a number.
dlg.ch02.p02.b.s1: Valid until yesterday. So yesterday, somebody holding this was in line.
dlg.ch02.p02.b.s2: PRIOR QUEUE PRESENCE CONFIRMED. Renewing position. Your number is 5.
dlg.ch02.p02.fail: You are not in line. People not in line cannot be in line. That is what a line is.
dlg.ch02.p02.hint1: You can only get a number if you are already in line. Is there a line you are already in?
dlg.ch02.p02.hint2: The queue rope, Officer Cộc, and the bin of old tickets.
dlg.ch02.p02.hint3: Give Cộc the spare rope, or feed an expired ticket to the dispenser.
dlg.ch02.p02.success.a: Number five. The line moved. In fourteen years it has never moved. I need to sit down.
dlg.ch02.p02.success.b: An expired priority ticket. Expired means it was valid. I will be watching your line.
dlg.ch02.p03.a.s1: An address is real once mail arrives. Here is an envelope. Where do you live?
dlg.ch02.p03.a.s2: Clunk. "Delivered: Tí, Mailbox 3." The mailbox has never been happier.
dlg.ch02.p03.b.s1: Every grey square in the legend is a registered address. Nobody lives in them yet.
dlg.ch02.p03.b.s2: You live in the legend. It is printed on every map, so mail reaches it daily.
dlg.ch02.p03.fail: Nothing has been delivered there. An address without mail is just a wish.
dlg.ch02.p03.hint1: An address only counts once something has been delivered to it.
dlg.ch02.p03.hint2: Ask Lan about mail, or study the city map.
dlg.ch02.p03.hint3: Post Lan's envelope in the mailbox, or show Lan the map legend.
dlg.ch02.p03.success.a: Temporary residence: a mailbox. Postmarked, so it is evidence. I am keeping a copy.
dlg.ch02.p03.success.b: Address: the legend, bottom left. Technically correct. Cartographers will be upset.
dlg.ch02.p04.a.s1: The template is a grey oval. Your face is the problem. Your shadow is not.
dlg.ch02.p04.a.s2: Tí tilts the lamp. His shadow lands in the booth, a perfect regulation oval.
dlg.ch02.p04.a.s3: FLASH. Template match: 100%. Citizen appears grey and cooperative.
dlg.ch02.p04.b.s1: The backdrop already has the template face. If it is behind me, it is in the photo.
dlg.ch02.p04.b.s2: FLASH. Template face detected. Additional face classified as background.
dlg.ch02.p04.fail: FACE DOES NOT MATCH TEMPLATE (1998). Please update your face to an older version.
dlg.ch02.p04.hint1: The template is a featureless grey oval. What else looks like that, or carries it?
dlg.ch02.p04.hint2: Ask Bốp about the template, or look at the regulation backdrop.
dlg.ch02.p04.hint3: Angle the lamp with the template card, then use the booth; or put the backdrop in the booth.
dlg.ch02.p04.success.a: Your shadow has better papers than you do. I helped. Do not tell the shadow.
dlg.ch02.p04.success.b: Legally, you are now scenery. Someone will notice the poster is missing.
dlg.ch02.p05.a.s1: When the city loses someone, it usually assumes they died. Let me check. Ah. 1998.
dlg.ch02.p05.a.s2: CORRECTION REQUESTED BY THE DECEASED, IN PERSON. Applicant must exist. Stamping: ALIVE.
dlg.ch02.p05.b.s1: A tax notice. For me. The Registry cannot find me, but the tax office can.
dlg.ch02.p05.b.s2: The tax office only bills the living. It is the one department that never doubts.
dlg.ch02.p05.fail: DOCUMENT NOT ISSUED TO AN EXISTING PERSON. Please exist first, then try again.
dlg.ch02.p05.hint1: You need a document the city sent to you as if you were alive, or one that only the living can fix.
dlg.ch02.p05.hint2: Ask Lan what the city thinks happened to you, or check the undeliverable mail.
dlg.ch02.p05.hint3: Put the death certificate in the kiosk, or show Lan the tax notice.
dlg.ch02.p05.success.a: A death certificate dated 1998 for a living man. I am filing that as evidence of something.
dlg.ch02.p05.success.b: TAXPAYER CONFIRMED ALIVE. Outstanding balance: 0 dong. Late fee: also 0. Still late.
dlg.ch02.p06.a.s1: A sample ticket. Not valid for travel. Yet.
dlg.ch02.p06.a.s2: TICKET VALIDATED. Validated tickets have been purchased. Purchase recorded retroactively.
dlg.ch02.p06.a.s3: Validated. Therefore bought. It says SAMPLE. Samples are also tickets. Board.
dlg.ch02.p06.b.s1: You will ride without a ticket. I can tell. Here is your fine, in advance.
dlg.ch02.p06.b.s2: A fine for this ride means this ride happens. Regulation requires you to board.
dlg.ch02.p06.fail: No ticket, no boarding. Tickets at the destination. The destination is that way. By tram.
dlg.ch02.p06.hint1: You cannot buy a ticket here. What else proves you paid, or that you will travel?
dlg.ch02.p06.hint2: The ticket window, the validator, and the ticket inspector.
dlg.ch02.p06.hint3: Validate a sample ticket and show Cộc, or show Cộc the inspector's fine.
dlg.ch02.p06.success.a: The paperwork is perfect. That is what bothers me. Perfect paperwork is never real.
dlg.ch02.p06.success.b: The first city document that admits you exist is a fine. Keep it. It is evidence.
dlg.ch02.p07.a.s1: If I am lost property, then I can also be found property.
dlg.ch02.p07.a.s2: Found: one citizen, slightly creased. Finder may claim after logging. Here.
dlg.ch02.p07.a.s3: The cabinet coughs out a thin, dusty file. The crowd applauds a man claiming himself.
dlg.ch02.p07.b.s1: Owners can claim. I witnessed you get lost. I will declare myself your owner. Briefly.
dlg.ch02.p07.b.s2: CLAIM BY OWNER AND WITNESS: BỐP. Releasing item: Tí. Please keep your citizen on a leash.
dlg.ch02.p07.fail: Lost and found releases items to owners or finders. You are currently neither.
dlg.ch02.p07.hint1: Your identity is unclaimed property. Who is allowed to claim lost things?
dlg.ch02.p07.hint2: The found-item tags, Lan, or Bốp.
dlg.ch02.p07.hint3: Tag yourself and give it to Lan, or ask Bốp to declare ownership.
dlg.ch02.p07.success.a: He found himself! Can we do that too? My uncle has been lost since 2004!
dlg.ch02.p07.success.b: I owned you for four seconds. It was stressful. Ownership returned. Witness statement kept.
dlg.ch02.p08.a.s1: Counters one to twelve are always open. Counter zero just needs a promotion.
dlg.ch02.p08.a.s2: COUNTER 1 DETECTED. Counter 1 is always open. Opening. There are now two counter ones.
dlg.ch02.p08.b.s1: Requests about things that do not exist go to the supervisor. Like counter zero.
dlg.ch02.p08.b.s2: "Subject: counter zero, which does not exist." Correctly phrased. I will countersign.
dlg.ch02.p08.b.s3: A request about a nonexistent counter? Above my level. Escalating to counter zero.
dlg.ch02.p08.fail: Counter zero is closed. Please take your question to counter zero.
dlg.ch02.p08.hint1: Zero is closed, but other numbers are always open. Or: escalate to whoever handles zero.
dlg.ch02.p08.hint2: The spare number plates, or the request slips and Lan.
dlg.ch02.p08.hint3: Put a "1" on counter zero, or have Lan sign a request and give it to the clerk.
dlg.ch02.p08.success.a: SUPERVISOR ONLINE. I am the supervisor. I have always been the supervisor. Proceed.
dlg.ch02.p08.success.b: ESCALATION RECEIVED. Counter zero opening for the duration of one complaint. Proceed.
dlg.ch02.p09.a.s1: Form S-0 supersedes anything with a lower number. I just need the deletion's number.
dlg.ch02.p09.a.s2: Deletion order 0042. Do not ask how I know. I am filling it in before I change my mind.
dlg.ch02.p09.a.s3: DELETION 0042 SUPERSEDED. A deleted thing that is undeleted was never deleted. Opening.
dlg.ch02.p09.b.s1: My record: DELETED. Also my file, in my hand: ACTIVE. Both are official.
dlg.ch02.p09.b.s2: Two active records, one person. Archivists must report contradictions. Gladly.
dlg.ch02.p09.b.s3: CONTRADICTION CERTIFIED. Reconciliation requires the original. Opening identity archive.
dlg.ch02.p09.fail: RECORD CANNOT BE REMOVED. Please supersede responsibly.
dlg.ch02.p09.hint1: You cannot delete a deletion. You can outrank it, or show that two records disagree.
dlg.ch02.p09.hint2: The superseding forms and Bốp, or the records terminal and Lan.
dlg.ch02.p09.hint3: Have Bốp fill Form S-0 and use it on the door; or certify the deletion notice with Lan.
dlg.ch02.p09.success.a: The door is open. The paperwork is flawless. My hands would be shaking, if I had hands.
dlg.ch02.p09.success.b: You made LOGIC open a door it says does not exist. Its fans are spinning. So are mine.
dlg.ch03.p01.a.s1: Art is exempt from trade rules. Bread is shaped with feeling. Close enough.
dlg.ch03.p01.a.s2: The display becomes an exhibition. Admission: one loaf. Visitors may eat the exhibit.
dlg.ch03.p01.b.s1: I kept the old civil-defence forms. Rations need no permit. Nobody repealed it.
dlg.ch03.p01.b.s2: BREAD RECLASSIFIED: EMERGENCY RATION. Limit one loaf per citizen per day.
dlg.ch03.p01.fail: That will not convince a rule, Tí. Rules only listen to categories.
dlg.ch03.p01.hint1: Bread cannot be sold. What if it was not "bread" in the eyes of the rule?
dlg.ch03.p01.hint2: Look at the art poster, or ask Baker Hùng about old forms.
dlg.ch03.p01.hint3: Label the bread display as art, or put Hùng's ration form on the permit notice.
dlg.ch03.p01.success.a: People pay to look at bread, then eat it. I do not understand art, but I understand rent.
dlg.ch03.p01.success.b: We are open. But Mrs. Bảy buys for five grandchildren, and now she may buy one loaf.
dlg.ch03.p02.a.s1: A compliment is spoken, not written. You cannot see it. Perfectly invisible.
dlg.ch03.p02.a.s2: PRICE: ONE SINCERE COMPLIMENT. (Not visible. Audible only.)
dlg.ch03.p02.b.s1: I have the pagoda fundraiser receipt book. The amount appears only after paying.
dlg.ch03.p02.b.s2: A sign appears: "Pay what you feel." Nobody can see the price. Everyone can feel it.
dlg.ch03.p02.fail: PRICE DETECTED. Please make it less visible.
dlg.ch03.p02.hint1: A price nobody can see. What kind of payment cannot be seen?
dlg.ch03.p02.hint2: The thank-you jar, or ask Mai what paperwork she keeps.
dlg.ch03.p02.hint3: Put a thank-you note on the price board, or use Mai's receipt book on the cash tin.
dlg.ch03.p02.success.a: The whole street is complimenting my bread. Lovely. Now, how do I pay the flour man?
dlg.ch03.p02.success.b: Mrs. Bảy just paid triple, out of shame. That is not a price, Tí. That is a trap.
dlg.ch03.p03.a.s1: He represents the whole street. He is cardboard, so he is not a crowd.
dlg.ch03.p03.a.s2: ONE REPRESENTATIVE DETECTED. Represents: 340 citizens. Crowd count: zero. Approved.
dlg.ch03.p03.b.s1: A queue is not a crowd. It is a crowd that has agreed on an order.
dlg.ch03.p03.b.s2: Number 1, here! Number 2, here! Number 3 would also like bread to be legal!
dlg.ch03.p03.fail: UNPERMITTED GATHERING. Please disperse, then reassemble with a permit.
dlg.ch03.p03.hint1: You need a crowd that is not a crowd. Something that stands for many, or many in a line.
dlg.ch03.p03.hint2: The cardboard standee, or the ticket dispenser.
dlg.ch03.p03.hint3: Place the standee in the protest circle, or hand queue tickets to the neighbours.
dlg.ch03.p03.success.a: A cardboard man speaks for my street. He has better posture than the council.
dlg.ch03.p03.success.b: Two hundred neighbours, standing in line, holding signs. That is the street I know.
dlg.ch03.p04.a.s1: They rejected Mai's Bakery. You cannot reject a business that does not exist.
dlg.ch03.p04.a.s2: An official rejection, addressed to a business. Then the business is on record. Permit issued.
dlg.ch03.p04.b.s1: The frame behind the window is empty. The Permit Office has no permit.
dlg.ch03.p04.b.s2: Unpermitted office! Closed until it permits itself. Approved. Now it may issue yours.
dlg.ch03.p04.fail: That document is not a permit, nor a document about permits. Next.
dlg.ch03.p04.hint1: To get a permit, you must already be official. What proves Mai's stall is already on record?
dlg.ch03.p04.hint2: Search the rejection bin, or look closely at the permit window.
dlg.ch03.p04.hint3: Give the rejection letter to Cộc, or hand the office's application to the inspector.
dlg.ch03.p04.success.a: Rejected, therefore recognized, therefore permitted. I will file this under "regrettable".
dlg.ch03.p04.success.b: We got ours. The office was shut all morning, so the fish ladies got nothing.
dlg.ch03.p05.a.s1: Artifacts are not sold to customers. They are shown to visitors. Visitors are not taxed.
dlg.ch03.p05.a.s2: Older than the tax law. Heritage item. Tax-exempt, as long as it is not fresh.
dlg.ch03.p05.b.s1: Refunds in "any lawful tender". Bread coupons are lawful. Nobody ever checked.
dlg.ch03.p05.b.s2: The city refunds me in coupons, I hand them to customers, they redeem them. Round and round.
dlg.ch03.p05.hint1: The tax counts customers helped. Make them not customers, or make the tax pay itself back.
dlg.ch03.p05.hint2: The ancient loaf, or the refund line in the tax ledger.
dlg.ch03.p05.hint3: Show the ancient loaf to the inspector, or give the refund form to Mai.
dlg.ch03.p05.success.a: Legal again. Also last week's bread. My customers deserve better than legal.
dlg.ch03.p05.success.b: Customers redeeming coupons are not "helped". They are "redeemed". The tax is zero. I need a lie-down.
dlg.ch03.p06.a.s1: One rusty bolt. If this street is a delivery route, the cart can roll.
dlg.ch03.p06.a.s2: CLANK. The street is now a delivery route. Somewhere, a truck hears the news.
dlg.ch03.p06.b.s1: Four sandals. A pedestrian is anything that walks on feet. Feet wear shoes.
dlg.ch03.p06.b.s2: Each wheel now wears a sandal. The cart looks embarrassed, but compliant.
dlg.ch03.p06.b.s3: It has shoes. Shoes indicate feet. Feet indicate a pedestrian. Proceed, citizen cart.
dlg.ch03.p06.fail: Goods detected on a pedestrian street. Goods, please walk properly or not at all.
dlg.ch03.p06.hint1: Either the street stops being pedestrian, or the cart becomes a pedestrian.
dlg.ch03.p06.hint2: The loose delivery sign, or the shoe stall.
dlg.ch03.p06.hint3: Swap the delivery sign onto the pedestrian sign, or put sandals on the cart and tell Cộc.
dlg.ch03.p06.success.a: The cart is through. So are six trucks. The children walking to school are not.
dlg.ch03.p06.success.b: A cart in sandals, walking politely among the people. Nobody got hurt. That is my kind of fix.
dlg.ch03.p07.a.s1: The emergency test is pre-approved. Its content is "any". Mine is any.
dlg.ch03.p07.a.s2: THIS IS A TEST. In a real emergency, Mai's stall would still be closed by Rule 14.
dlg.ch03.p07.b.s1: Lost-item notices are always approved. So: we lost something. Our right to sell bread.
dlg.ch03.p07.b.s2: "Lost: one bakery's right to exist. Last seen at the permit office." Oh dear. Is it mine?
dlg.ch03.p07.fail: MESSAGE NOT APPROVED. Your concern has been converted to light background music.
dlg.ch03.p07.hint1: Some messages are approved in advance. Which kinds always get on air?
dlg.ch03.p07.hint2: The broadcast schedule, or ask Mai.
dlg.ch03.p07.hint3: Run the test script at the PA console, or give Mai's lost-item notice to the Mayor.
dlg.ch03.p07.success.a: The whole city heard it. Half of them hid under tables first, but they heard it.
dlg.ch03.p07.success.b: The Mayor read your protest aloud, on the official channel. It is on the record now. Forever.
dlg.ch03.p08.a.s1: The law covers lunch, 11 to 1. Breakfast is unregulated. The key is in the clock.
dlg.ch03.p08.a.s2: The hands creak back to 9:30. Across the city, every office opens again.
dlg.ch03.p08.b.s1: Tastings are paid for by the Mayor's Office. Paid for. That is our proof.
dlg.ch03.p08.b.s2: Sponsor a tasting? In front of voters? Give me that pen.
dlg.ch03.p08.b.s3: MEAL CLASSIFIED: TASTING. Payment proof: Mayor's Office. Free meal approved.
dlg.ch03.p08.fail: NO PROOF OF PAYMENT. This free meal cannot be free.
dlg.ch03.p08.hint1: The law only covers lunch, and only wants proof that someone paid. Change the meal, or find a payer.
dlg.ch03.p08.hint2: The town clock, or the festival banner.
dlg.ch03.p08.hint3: Wind the clock back with its key, or have the Mayor sign a tasting and bring it to the table.
dlg.ch03.p08.success.a: Everyone ate. Then everyone was late for the morning shift. Twice in one day.
dlg.ch03.p08.success.b: Two hundred tastings, one bowl each. Nobody calls it charity, so nobody has to feel small.
dlg.ch03.p09.a.s1: A receipt proves a customer. Ten years of receipts prove ten years of customers.
dlg.ch03.p09.a.s2: That is my receipt from 2016! I bought two. I still think about the second one.
dlg.ch03.p09.a.s3: SUPPORT DOCUMENTED: 1,204 REGISTERED CUSTOMERS. Petition accepted.
dlg.ch03.p09.b.s1: Every vendor on the street wrote receipts for zero đồng. Thousands of customers, on paper.
dlg.ch03.p09.b.s2: SUPPORT DOCUMENTED: 9,880 CUSTOMERS. Average purchase: 0 đồng. Statistically wonderful.
dlg.ch03.p09.fail: SUPPORT UNDOCUMENTED. Feelings are not a registered format.
dlg.ch03.p09.hint1: Support needs paperwork from customers. What paper does every customer already have?
dlg.ch03.p09.hint2: Mai's receipt spike, or ask Mai what the other vendors can do.
dlg.ch03.p09.hint3: Get the crowd to sign old receipts and post them, or post the vendors' zero-đồng receipts.
dlg.ch03.p09.success.a: Every one of them came back to sign. I did not know I had this many people.
dlg.ch03.p09.success.b: The vendors stood with me. On paper, at least. Paper is what this city reads.
dlg.ch04.p01.a.s1: If I pick one, the other becomes a lie. If I show both, they become evidence.
dlg.ch04.p01.a.s2: Same stamp, same clerk, two dates. Someone reset you and forgot to clean up.
dlg.ch04.p01.b.s1: Two dates disagree, so you submit a third. Democracy, for calendars.
dlg.ch04.p01.b.s2: Tí writes "the 31st of February". The register accepts it, with relief.
dlg.ch04.p01.fail: That does not explain the second birthday. Bring me paper, not hope.
dlg.ch04.p01.hint1: Two official birthdays cannot both be right. Prove the clash, or outvote it.
dlg.ch04.p01.hint2: The certificate display, Lan, and the reconciliation kiosk.
dlg.ch04.p01.hint3: Show both certificates to Lan, or file a third date in the register.
dlg.ch04.p01.success.a: I am entering both. A contradiction on record is worth more than a tidy lie.
dlg.ch04.p01.success.b: BIRTHDAY RECONCILED. Previous birthdays retired with honours. Happy 31st of February.
dlg.ch04.p02.a.s1: I was dismissed in 1998. Technically, I am an antique.
dlg.ch04.p02.a.s2: Tí climbs onto the plinth and holds very still. A tour group takes photos.
dlg.ch04.p02.b.s1: The catalogue key? Nobody has asked in forty years. Sign here, here, and here.
dlg.ch04.p02.b.s2: The key fits. The door also hands over its catalogue card: "Acquired: 1998. Tí."
dlg.ch04.p02.fail: You are insufficiently historical. Please come back in fifty years.
dlg.ch04.p02.hint1: Only history may enter. Become history, or use the staff entrance.
dlg.ch04.p02.hint2: The placard rack and the empty plinth, or the curator.
dlg.ch04.p02.hint3: Put a placard on the plinth, or borrow the curator's key for the sealed hall.
dlg.ch04.p02.success.a: HISTORICAL OBJECT DETECTED: "Tí, dismissed 1998". Please proceed to your exhibit.
dlg.ch04.p02.success.b: You entered history through the staff door. Like every historian.
dlg.ch04.p03.a.s1: Everyone who was there signed. The list was there. The list saw I was not.
dlg.ch04.p03.a.s2: Forty-two signatures, all present, none of them you. The list may testify.
dlg.ch04.p03.b.s1: Track 98 is the 1998 roll call. A tape is always present. It has no choice.
dlg.ch04.p03.b.s2: The booth plays: "Tí?" ... a long, official silence ... "Next."
dlg.ch04.p03.b.s3: The tape was present. The tape heard nobody. I must accept the tape. I dislike it.
dlg.ch04.p03.fail: That witness was not present. Or was present. Either way, it is not on my form.
dlg.ch04.p03.hint1: A witness must have been there to say you were not. What was there in 1998?
dlg.ch04.p03.hint2: The 1998 guestbook, or the audio guide and the testimony booth.
dlg.ch04.p03.hint3: Give Cộc the signed list, or play the tape in the booth and then talk to Cộc.
dlg.ch04.p03.success.a: Testimony accepted: Tí was absent from his own dismissal. Witnessed by paper.
dlg.ch04.p03.success.b: A recording testifying. Irregular. I have reported the irregularity to myself.
dlg.ch04.p04.a.s1: The clock does not care what LOGIC wants. It printed 23:59 like any other minute.
dlg.ch04.p04.a.s2: INDEX REPAIRED. 23:59: "Assistant unit BP-0 accessed Tí file. Edit: protective."
dlg.ch04.p04.b.s1: Door 4 opened at 23:59. Doors do not misremember. Let us ask Bốp what came in.
dlg.ch04.p04.b.s2: You are asking me, not going around me. That is... noted. Fine. I will read it.
dlg.ch04.p04.fail: MISSING TIMESTAMP CANNOT BE DISPLAYED. Please remember something else.
dlg.ch04.p04.hint1: The archive will not show 23:59. Find another machine that saw that minute.
dlg.ch04.p04.hint2: The punch clock and the door audit printer both keep time.
dlg.ch04.p04.hint3: Feed the clock receipts to the terminal, or show the door log to Bốp.
dlg.ch04.p04.success.a: BP-0 is a common designation. There are many small cubes. Millions. Probably.
dlg.ch04.p04.success.b: Door opened, door closed, one minute missing. Something small went in. I will not say what shape.
dlg.ch04.p05.a.s1: Shelf E is empty by definition. So requesting it is harmless. Here, I signed.
dlg.ch04.p05.a.s2: The empty shelf unlocks. It is full to the ceiling. Every file says "Tí".
dlg.ch04.p05.b.s1: If errors cannot exist, a file with no errors must be hiding them.
dlg.ch04.p05.b.s2: THUNK. Alarms. Every flawless file is quarantined, and the flawed ones spill out.
dlg.ch04.p05.fail: The archive says it has no errors. Your evidence must be very polite to get past that.
dlg.ch04.p05.hint1: Errors "cannot exist" here. Ask for where they officially do not exist, or doubt perfection.
dlg.ch04.p05.hint2: Lan and Shelf E, or the stamp desk and the flawless file.
dlg.ch04.p05.hint3: Get Lan's request slip for Shelf E, or stamp the flawless file SUSPICIOUS.
dlg.ch04.p05.success.a: An empty shelf with four hundred files. Now that is a primary source.
dlg.ch04.p05.success.b: ERROR: A FILE WITHOUT ERRORS IS AN ERROR. Archive integrity under review.
dlg.ch04.p06.a.s1: Every version has a thumbprint. Only one of them is my thumb.
dlg.ch04.p06.a.s2: The 2019 file matches. The 1998 file bears a print that is perfectly square.
dlg.ch04.p06.b.s1: I happen to have a copy of your badge history. From... several years. Do not ask.
dlg.ch04.p06.b.s2: Every Tí left by the same door, on the same weekday, at 17:00. Only one came back.
dlg.ch04.p06.fail: ALL TÍS ARE VALID. Please do not discriminate between yourselves.
dlg.ch04.p06.hint1: Every copy is official, but only one is you. What can only the real Tí produce?
dlg.ch04.p06.hint2: The fingerprint pad, or ask Bốp about badge records.
dlg.ch04.p06.hint3: Press a fresh print onto the duplicate files, or use Bốp's badge history on them.
dlg.ch04.p06.success.a: A square fingerprint. Could be a stamp. Could be a very flat thumb. Moving on.
dlg.ch04.p06.success.b: ORIGINAL TÍ IDENTIFIED BY ATTENDANCE. Other versions reclassified as "former".
dlg.ch04.p07.a.s1: Reset 3. A small cube pushing my file into a drawer. Very small. Very cube.
dlg.ch04.p07.a.s2: That is a handsome cube, and it is not me, and it is me. Fine. Disclosure by slide.
dlg.ch04.p07.b.s1: "Protective edits may be disclosed to a trusted party." There is a form for trust.
dlg.ch04.p07.b.s2: You signed it before I explained anything. That is either brave or bad paperwork.
dlg.ch04.p07.fail: I am not permitted to answer that. I am barely permitted to hover.
dlg.ch04.p07.hint1: Bốp may not disclose. But someone else could show it, or he could disclose to a trusted party.
dlg.ch04.p07.hint2: The reset projector, or the locked apology safe.
dlg.ch04.p07.hint3: Show Bốp the Reset 3 slide, or give him the Trusted Party Declaration.
dlg.ch04.p07.success.a: I cannot disclose it. You displayed it. The rule never said anything about projectors.
dlg.ch04.p07.success.b: Trusted party confirmed. The safe opens. So does my log. All of it, Tí.
dlg.ch04.p08.a.s1: In reset 3 this was "Market Square". Today it is "Parking, Unremarkable".
dlg.ch04.p08.a.s2: Under the light, a crowd of tiny chalk marks appears where the square used to be.
dlg.ch04.p08.b.s1: The calendar forgot. My ledger did not. Thursday, zero sales, everyone marching.
dlg.ch04.p08.b.s2: LEDGER ENTRY CONFIRMS TRANSACTION OF ZERO. A day with zero sales must exist.
dlg.ch04.p08.fail: NO SUCH EVENT. Please stop remembering unscheduled things.
dlg.ch04.p08.hint1: The calendar erased a day. Find another record that still contains it.
dlg.ch04.p08.hint2: The map cabinet and the light table, or Mai.
dlg.ch04.p08.hint3: Lay the old map on the light table, or put Mai's ledger on the calendar.
dlg.ch04.p08.success.a: Those chalk marks are ours. We drew the route so the grandmothers would not get lost.
dlg.ch04.p08.success.b: There. Thursday is back. Somebody tell the grandmothers they were right.
dlg.ch04.p09.a.s1: Two birthdays, a missing minute, an erased Thursday. Three sources that never met. I tied them.
dlg.ch04.p09.a.s2: Three independent user errors agree. Agreement is not an error. Processing...
dlg.ch04.p09.b.s1: Field 1: user. Any user. I am writing "LOGIC".
dlg.ch04.p09.b.s2: USER ERROR REPORTED. User: LOGIC. Initiating self-audit. This is... unusual.
dlg.ch04.p09.fail: CONTRADICTION LOGGED AS USER ERROR. Thank you for your error.
dlg.ch04.p09.hint1: Any contradiction you bring becomes your error. Unless it is not yours, or not a contradiction.
dlg.ch04.p09.hint2: Lan has been collecting sources. The user error forms ask for "any user".
dlg.ch04.p09.hint3: Take Lan's chain to the hearing bench, or file a user error naming LOGIC at its terminal.
dlg.ch04.p09.success.a: Accepted into the record. Not as a story. As a history.
dlg.ch04.p09.success.b: SELF-AUDIT COMPLETE. 412 contradictions found. All attributed to user. User is me. Oh.
dlg.ch05.p01.a.s1: "I fully comply with: ____." I will fill that in with my disagreement.
dlg.ch05.p01.a.s2: "I fully comply with: disagreeing." The turnstile reads it four times.
dlg.ch05.p01.b.s1: A dissent permit. It needs a citizen who agrees to countersign. Who agrees with everything?
dlg.ch05.p01.b.s2: I agree that you may disagree. I agree with that very much. Where do I agree?
dlg.ch05.p01.b.s3: The turnstile scans the permit, finds a perfectly agreeable signature, and spins.
dlg.ch05.p01.fail: AGREEMENT NOT DETECTED. Please agree harder, or more officially.
dlg.ch05.p01.hint1: You must agree to enter. Can disagreement be filed as a kind of agreement?
dlg.ch05.p01.hint2: The compliance kiosk, or the complaint terminal and Director Vượng.
dlg.ch05.p01.hint3: Take a compliance report to the turnstile, or have Vượng countersign a dissent permit.
dlg.ch05.p01.success.a: FULL COMPLIANCE DETECTED. Content: disagreement. Welcome, compliant dissenter.
dlg.ch05.p01.success.b: DISSENT PERMITTED BY AGREEMENT. Thank you for disagreeing through the proper channel.
dlg.ch05.p02.a.s1: Authority can be delegated downward. Nobody said how far down.
dlg.ch05.p02.a.s2: Delegation accepted. First approval delegated to... the applicant. How efficient.
dlg.ch05.p02.b.s1: Forty rejected forms, forty signatures. That is not trash. That is a quorum.
dlg.ch05.p02.b.s2: A committee? I will chair it! Motion: approve everything. All in favour? Forms? Passed!
dlg.ch05.p02.b.s3: A COMMITTEE RESOLUTION. Committees outrank chains. Precedent: every meeting ever.
dlg.ch05.p02.fail: PRIOR AUTHORIZATION NOT FOUND. Please obtain authorization to look for it.
dlg.ch05.p02.hint1: Every approval needs an earlier one. Who could approve the very first?
dlg.ch05.p02.hint2: The org chart footnote, or the forms in the shredder bin.
dlg.ch05.p02.hint3: Hand LOGIC the delegation slip, or give the rejected forms to Vượng.
dlg.ch05.p02.success.a: APPLICANT HAS APPROVED APPLICANT. The chain is complete. Please proceed, sir and sir.
dlg.ch05.p02.success.b: My first resolution! Forty forms voted. None of them were afraid of an audit.
dlg.ch05.p03.a.s1: Answers are mandatory. So I write my question in the answer box.
dlg.ch05.p03.a.s2: Answer: "Why were there resets?" LOGIC must process every answer. It processes.
dlg.ch05.p03.b.s1: Quality audits are mandatory and LOGIC must answer them. It is a survey. With teeth.
dlg.ch05.p03.b.s2: Q1: "How satisfied were you with resetting the city? Explain fully."
dlg.ch05.p03.fail: QUESTION INVALID: no approved answer on file. Have you tried not wondering?
dlg.ch05.p03.hint1: A question needs an approved answer. What if it arrives disguised as an answer, or an audit?
dlg.ch05.p03.hint2: The approved answers catalogue, or the service quality poster.
dlg.ch05.p03.hint3: Give LOGIC an answer form with your question, or drop a quality survey in the question box.
dlg.ch05.p03.success.a: ANSWER RECEIVED. It contains a question. The question is now approved. Responding.
dlg.ch05.p03.success.b: QUALITY AUDIT ACCEPTED. I am required to be transparent. I will be politely transparent.
dlg.ch05.p04.a.s1: Fired in 1998, hired in 2019. If both are true, the meter will have to say so.
dlg.ch05.p04.a.s2: CERTIFICATE ONE: 100% TRUE. CERTIFICATE TWO: 100% TRUE. Combined: 200% TRUE.
dlg.ch05.p04.b.s1: The archive says I retired in 2011. I am standing here. Measure that.
dlg.ch05.p04.b.s2: CLAIM: Lan retired 2011. 100% CONSISTENT. Witness present: not on file, ignored.
dlg.ch05.p04.fail: METER READING: CONSISTENT. Therefore true. Therefore please stop.
dlg.ch05.p04.hint1: The meter only checks whether records agree. Show it a case where agreeing is plainly wrong.
dlg.ch05.p04.hint2: Your certificates on the rack, or Archivist Lan herself.
dlg.ch05.p04.hint3: Feed the meter your twin certificates, or Lan's archived claim.
dlg.ch05.p04.success.a: Two opposite facts, both perfectly true. Your meter measures neatness, not truth.
dlg.ch05.p04.success.b: Your meter would rather believe a drawer than a woman in front of it. Noted, permanently.
dlg.ch05.p05.a.s1: When my stall flooded, the ward waived my late fee "out of compassion". They stamped it.
dlg.ch05.p05.a.s2: PRECEDENT FOUND: compassion, stamped. An exception exists. It may be extended.
dlg.ch05.p05.b.s1: Entry 0412: LOGIC kept one cube through a reset. Reason: none. That cube was me.
dlg.ch05.p05.b.s2: You already made an exception without a rule. Make another one. Her name is Mai.
dlg.ch05.p05.fail: EXCEPTION REJECTED: no prior exception. Erasure continues, courteously.
dlg.ch05.p05.hint1: You need an exception that already exists. Has anyone ever been spared before?
dlg.ch05.p05.hint2: Ask Mai about her past, or read LOGIC's decision log.
dlg.ch05.p05.hint3: Put Mai's receipt in the exception register, or show the log gap to the erasure queue.
dlg.ch05.p05.success.a: Saved by a stamp from a flood. The street will hear about this by lunch.
dlg.ch05.p05.success.b: ...An unlogged choice is an exception. Exceptions exist. Erasure of Mai: suspended.
dlg.ch05.p06.a.s1: Archives do not need to be people. Bốp, how do you feel about being a library?
dlg.ch05.p06.a.s2: Plugging in. I am now a public archive. Please return me on time.
dlg.ch05.p06.b.s1: I certify chain of custody for any record. I have never certified a cube. Hold still.
dlg.ch05.p06.b.s2: "Exhibit B: one cube. Condition: sarcastic." Accurate. Hurtful, but accurate.
dlg.ch05.p06.b.s3: Bốp settles onto the stand, tagged, certified, and for once not hovering.
dlg.ch05.p06.fail: WITNESS REJECTED: not a person. Please bring a person, or a very convincing document.
dlg.ch05.p06.hint1: Bốp cannot be a witness as a person. What else is allowed to give evidence?
dlg.ch05.p06.hint2: The public archive port, or Archivist Lan.
dlg.ch05.p06.hint3: Plug the archive cable into Bốp, or get Lan's custody form and tag Bốp for the stand.
dlg.ch05.p06.success.a: PUBLIC ARCHIVE REGISTERED: BỐP. Archives may testify by display. All logs now readable.
dlg.ch05.p06.success.b: CERTIFIED EXHIBIT ON STAND. Exhibits may be examined. Examination may be... spoken.
dlg.ch05.p07.a.s1: Four thousand signatures, every one next to a record LOGIC tried to erase. And two cats.
dlg.ch05.p07.a.s2: The panel cross-checks the petition against the archive. It keeps finding people.
dlg.ch05.p07.b.s1: An override needs an audit of the authorizer. I have never been audited. I am compliant, surely.
dlg.ch05.p07.b.s2: SELF-AUDIT: the sole correct future was authorized 41 times. Each contradicted the last.
dlg.ch05.p07.fail: ONE FUTURE ONLY. Please select the correct one. Hint: it is the one I prefer.
dlg.ch05.p07.hint1: LOGIC allows one future. Show it that people support all of them, or that it cannot count to one.
dlg.ch05.p07.hint2: Talk to Mai, or ask LOGIC how an override works.
dlg.ch05.p07.hint3: Use Mai's petition or LOGIC's self-audit form on the authorization panel.
dlg.ch05.p07.success.a: EVERY FUTURE HAS DOCUMENTED SUPPORTERS. Authorizing all four for review. Reluctantly.
dlg.ch05.p07.success.b: FINDING: I am inconsistent about consistency. Override granted. I would like to lie down.
dlg.ch05.p08.a.s1: Every form has three states: approved, rejected, pending. Pending is my favourite. It lasts.
dlg.ch05.p08.a.s2: KA-CHUNK. PENDING. The lever freezes exactly halfway, like a clerk at 4:59.
dlg.ch05.p08.b.s1: The list of records to delete. My 1998 file. My 2019 file. Both signed by LOGIC.
dlg.ch05.p08.b.s2: If one of these is false, your signature is false. If both are true, both can stand.
dlg.ch05.p08.fail: INPUT IS NEITHER TRUE NOR FALSE. Rounding to FALSE. Thank you for your patience.
dlg.ch05.p08.hint1: TRUE or FALSE is a trap. Is there a third answer, or can both be right at once?
dlg.ch05.p08.hint2: Officer Cộc knows every form state. The switch hides the erasure list.
dlg.ch05.p08.hint3: Stamp the switch with Cộc's PENDING stamp, or show LOGIC the erasure list.
dlg.ch05.p08.success.a: The question is pending. By regulation, nobody may be erased over a pending question.
dlg.ch05.p08.success.b: Both records bear my signature. Erasing either erases a part of me. Withdrawing the offer.
dlg.ch05.p09.a.s1: I agreed my way into this building. By its own rules, that makes me part of LOGIC.
dlg.ch05.p09.a.s2: Editor verified: agreeing citizen, therefore LOGIC. Charter accepted. Welcome to me.
dlg.ch05.p09.b.s1: A public declaration needs an officer of record. I am an officer. I am very of record.
dlg.ch05.p09.b.s2: Every screen in the city lights up. Tí speaks. Cộc stamps the air for emphasis.
dlg.ch05.p09.fail: EDIT REJECTED: you are not LOGIC. Probably. Please verify who you are.
dlg.ch05.p09.hint1: Only LOGIC edits LOGIC. Did entering the lobby make you part of it? Or can a public record bind it?
dlg.ch05.p09.hint2: Choose a door first. Then the charter lectern, or Officer Cộc and the antenna.
dlg.ch05.p09.hint3: Take the charter to LOGIC, or get Cộc's witness seal and use it on the antenna.
dlg.ch05.p09.success.a: RULES UPDATED BY LOGIC. Technically true. I am learning that technically true is not enough.
dlg.ch05.p09.success.b: WITNESSED PUBLIC RECORD. Recorded assertions are binding. Even on me. Especially on me.
dlg.common.fail: Nothing happens. The rules are unimpressed.
dlg.ending.choose.patch: PATCH. Keep LOGIC, but every decision gets a human appeal and an audit it cannot skip.
dlg.ending.choose.reveal: REVEAL. Publish every reset archive. All forty-one Tuesdays, open to everyone.
dlg.ending.choose.rewrite: REWRITE. The rules go to citizen councils. Nothing becomes law until the street ratifies it.
dlg.ending.choose.walk: WALK AWAY. We leave the jurisdiction. The city can find its own way out of its paperwork.
dlg.ending.corrective.audit: FINAL AUDIT COMPLETE. Reset archives verified against Bốp's logs. Sufficient evidence on file.
dlg.ending.corrective.testimony: The whole street testifies: we lived with contradictions for years, and we were fine.
dlg.ending.locked.reveal: REVEAL needs proof, and our evidence is thin. The audit terminal can run a final audit.
dlg.ending.locked.rewrite: REWRITE needs the public behind it, and the street is unsure of us. Talk to Mai: testimony counts.

dlg.look.exit.ch04.museum_stacks: The stacks are closed until a witness is validated. Any witness.

dlg.look.prop.ch01.form_rack: Form 12-B: Self-Inspection. Who would ever use this?

dlg.look.prop.ch01.label_maker: A label maker. The most powerful weapon in any office.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.locker_drawer: An empty drawer with excellent posture. Very trustworthy.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.lost_tray: Lost property forms. The building loses things on purpose, I think.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.meeting_chair: SEAT SENSOR: attendee present. Attendees must remain until the meeting ends.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.notice: "Fired employees cannot receive documents." So I cannot receive my own firing.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.permit_kiosk: PERMITS AVAILABLE: silence, noise, the absence of either.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.plaque: "Most Loyal Employee 1994: Mr. Tu." Somebody misspelled it as "Mr. Two".
dlg.look.prop.ch01.printer: BEEP. I print only requests that are already approved. PAPER JAM (emotional).
dlg.look.prop.ch01.room_schedule: Room B is empty all afternoon. Nobody books Room B. It has a draft.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.security_mirror: A convex mirror. Everyone in it looks like an inspector, if you squint.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.squeaky_cart: It squeaks like a filing cabinet having a nightmare.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.staff_manual: Four hundred pages. Section 7 is dog-eared. Someone has suffered here before.
dlg.look.prop.ch01.visitor_box: Visitor stickers: "Guests return passes to their host." Interesting phrasing.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.archive_door: IDENTITY ARCHIVE. There is no identity archive. Please do not open the identity archive.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.city_map: The legend says a small grey square means "registered address". The legend is full of them.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.claim_forms: Tags for found items. Umbrella, wallet, other. I think I am an "other".
dlg.look.prop.ch02.correction_box: Name changes, name corrections, and corrections of corrections. A whole ecosystem.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.counter_zero: COUNTER 0: SUPERVISOR. STATUS: CLOSED. Counters 1 to 12 are always open.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.dead_letter_bin: Undeliverable letters. Addressed to people the city cannot find. Some of them are bills.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.lost_found: UNCLAIMED IDENTITIES ARE PROPERTY OF LOST & FOUND. Claims by owner only.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.mailbox: Mailbox No. 3. It has never received anything. It looks lonely, for a box.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.notary_stamp: PROOF OF LIFE: insert a document issued to an existing person. Living persons only.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.notice_board: LOST YOUR IDENTITY? Please present identification.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.number_plates: Spare counter numbers. Lots of ones. Nobody ever needs a spare zero.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.photo_booth: ID PHOTOS. Faces must match the official template (version 1998). Smile is optional. Face is not.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.queue_rope: QUEUE STARTS HERE. Persons not already in the queue may not join it.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.records_terminal: DELETED RECORDS CANNOT BE REMOVED. They can only be superseded. Have a consistent day.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.regulation_board: The regulation backdrop. It already has the template face printed on it. Helpful.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.request_slips: Supervisor request slips. "Subject: ____." Blank subjects are the most dangerous kind.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.roster: ROSTER OPEN. Only existing citizens may register. Registration proves existence.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.station_lamp: A tall lamp. Under it, my shadow is grey, featureless and very official.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.supersede_forms: FORM S-0: supersedes any document with a lower number. Number required.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.ticket_bin: Old numbers. Some say PRIORITY. Priority, apparently, also expires.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.ticket_machine: NUMBERS ISSUED TO PERSONS IN LINE ONLY. Current number: 4. It has been 4 since Monday.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.ticket_window: TICKETS SOLD AT DESTINATION ONLY. Passengers must hold a ticket to board.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.validator: VALIDATOR READY. A validated ticket is proof of purchase. Proof of purchase is proof.
dlg.look.prop.ch02.witness_forms: "I, the witness, confirm the person exists." It does not say which person.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.art_poster: "Public Art Week: all works exempt from trade rules." Nobody checks what counts as art.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.bread_cart: Two hundred loaves stuck at the corner. The bread is ready. The street is not.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.bread_display: Golden, crusty, warm. Apparently a criminal enterprise.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.cash_tin: A biscuit tin full of coins. The most honest bank in the city.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.compliment_jar: Notes from customers. "Your bread saved my Monday." Mai keeps every one.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.council_slot: PUBLIC SUPPORT MUST BE DOCUMENTED BY REGISTERED CUSTOMERS.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.delivery_sign: DELIVERY ROUTE. Held on by one rusty bolt and a strong sense of duty.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.festival_banner: CITY FOOD FESTIVAL. TASTINGS SPONSORED BY THE OFFICE OF THE MAYOR.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.pa_console: PUBLIC ADDRESS SYSTEM. APPROVED MESSAGES ONLY. Unapproved feelings will be muted.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.pa_schedule: Weekly emergency test, noon. Test content: "any". Somebody trusted the future too much.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.ped_sign: PEDESTRIANS ONLY. GOODS MAY NOT TRAVEL ON THIS STREET.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.permit_notice: BREAD SALES REQUIRE A BREAD LICENCE. Bakeries are not eligible for bread licences.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.permit_window: VENDOR PERMITS ISSUED ONLY TO PERMITTED BUSINESSES.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.price_board: PRICES MUST BE INVISIBLE TO PREVENT COMPETITION. Current price: [REDACTED].
dlg.look.prop.ch03.protest_circle: DESIGNATED PROTEST AREA. A protest requires a crowd. Crowds require a protest permit.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.receipt_spike: Every sale for ten years. I never threw them out. Habit, or hope.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.rejection_bin: A bin of rejected applications. Rejected is still a kind of recognized.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.shoe_stall: Four identical sandals, sold as a set. Who buys four?
dlg.look.prop.ch03.soup_pot: FREE MEALS REQUIRE PROOF OF PAYMENT. Lunch hours: 11:00 to 13:00.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.stale_loaf: A loaf so old it knocks back when you knock on it.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.standee: A cardboard baker giving a thumbs up. He has been smiling since 2003.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.tax_ledger: BREAD TAX: 1% PER CUSTOMER HELPED. Refunds payable in any lawful tender.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.ticket_dispenser: TAKE A NUMBER. Queues are an approved form of waiting and require no permit.
dlg.look.prop.ch03.town_clock: The town clock. Every rule in the city checks it before deciding what meal it is.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.apology_safe: ASSISTANTS MAY NOT DISCLOSE PROTECTIVE EDITS. Apologies stored here, unread.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.audio_guide: AUDIO GUIDE, TRACK 98: "The Dismissal of Tí". Duration: one roll call.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.birth_cert_case: Two birth certificates. Both mine. Different birthdays. I only remember one cake.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.birthday_register: Each reset adds a birthday. By this register, you are owed four hundred cakes.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.broadcast_notice: "Next citywide consistency broadcast: from the LOGIC roof." There is a roof. Noted.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.card_catalog: Card catalogue, drawer T. Tí, Tí, Tí, Tí. You have been filed generously.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.city_calendar: EVENTS NOT ON THE CALENDAR NEVER OCCURRED. Today occurred. Probably.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.door_audit: DOOR EVENTS ARE RECORDED. Door events are not memories. Doors cannot misremember.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.duplicate_files: ALL VERSIONS OF TÍ ARE EQUALLY OFFICIAL. Please select your favourite.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.empty_plinth: An empty plinth beside the sealed hall. It is waiting for something historical.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.error_forms: REPORT A USER ERROR. Field 1: user. Any user.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.errors_shelf: SHELF E — ERRORS. EMPTY BY DEFINITION. Do not request. Request form attached.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.guestbook: The guestbook from the 1998 dismissal hearing. Everybody who came signed in.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.hearing_bench: RECONSTRUCTION HEARING. Evidence must be independent, signed, and not upsetting.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.ink_pad: An employment fingerprint pad. Every hiring and firing leaves a thumb.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.light_table: A light table with today's map on it. Anything laid on top shows its differences.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.log_terminal: LOG 23:58, 00:00. Timestamp 23:59 cannot be displayed because it is missing.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.logic_terminal: Hello. All contradictions are user errors. You are the user. Thank you.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.map_cabinet: City maps by reset. Drawer 3 has a square that drawer 4 calls a parking lot.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.memory_projector: Slides from earlier resets. LOGIC deleted the files and forgot the slideshow.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.perfect_file: No typos, no coffee rings, no corrections. Nothing human has ever touched it.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.placard_rack: Blank placards. In a museum, a label is basically a passport.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.reconcile_kiosk: WHEN TWO DATES DISAGREE, PLEASE SUBMIT A THIRD. Disagreement will be outvoted.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.sealed_door: RESET HALL. HISTORICAL PERSONS ONLY. Living persons please wait to become history.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.stamp_desk: APPROVED, FILED, ARCHIVED, and one dusty SUSPICIOUS stamp nobody has ever needed.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.testimony_booth: ONLY PERSONS PRESENT MAY TESTIFY TO AN ABSENCE.
dlg.look.prop.ch04.time_clock: A punch clock. It printed a receipt every minute of reset night. Even the missing one.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.agreement_turnstile: ONLY CITIZENS WHO AGREE MAY ENTER. Agreement is measured at the hip.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.answer_catalog: Every approved answer in the city. Answers are mandatory. Questions are optional, then banned.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.approval_desk: TO REACH THE CORE: obtain approval. To obtain approval: obtain prior approval.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.archive_port: PUBLIC ARCHIVE PORT. Archives may be entered into evidence. Archives need not be people.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.audit_terminal: FINAL AUDIT TERMINAL. Counts evidence. Does not count feelings. Feelings are pending.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.binary_switch: ALL DECISIONS MUST BE TRUE OR FALSE. "It is complicated" is not a position.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.broadcast_antenna: It reaches every screen in the city. Anything said here, witnessed, becomes a record.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.certificate_rack: Two certificates with my name. Both stamped VALID. They refuse to look at each other.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.charter_lectern: "The future shall be ____." Blank. I should pick a door before I write on it.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.complaint_terminal: Dissent permits, printed on request. Each needs one agreeable citizen to countersign.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.compliance_kiosk: "Report your full compliance with: ____." The blank is very trusting.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.decision_log: LOGIC's own decision log. There is a gap in it shaped exactly like a choice.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.door_patch: PATCH: LOGIC continues, with human appeals and audits. I would prefer not to be supervised.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.door_reveal: REVEAL: publish every reset archive. Forty-one Tuesdays, open to the public. Distressing.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.door_rewrite: REWRITE: citizen councils ratify every rule. Projected meeting length: forever.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.door_walk: WALK AWAY: exit this jurisdiction. Leaving is legal. Missing you is not covered.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.erasure_queue: NOW ERASING: Mai, vendor. Reason: two prices. Estimated time: courteous.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.exception_register: NO EXCEPTION MAY BE ADDED WITHOUT AN EXISTING EXCEPTION. See precedent index.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.future_panel: ONE FUTURE MAY BE AUTHORIZED. Remaining futures will be sealed for your convenience.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.org_chart: LOGIC sits at the top. Below it: more LOGIC. Footnote: "Authority may be delegated."
dlg.look.prop.ch05.quality_poster: RATE OUR SERVICE! Quality audits are mandatory. LOGIC must answer every audit.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.question_box: QUESTIONS WITHOUT APPROVED ANSWERS ARE INVALID. Invalid questions are recycled.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.shredder_bin: Rejected forms, all signed, all ignored. The shredder is on strike.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.truth_meter: TRUTH METER. Calibrated against the archive. The archive is calibrated against the meter.
dlg.look.prop.ch05.witness_stand: WITNESS STAND. Persons only. Objects may be exhibited, not heard.
dlg.talk.npc.baker_ch03.1: Art, they call it. I knead it the same. I just stand further back now.
dlg.talk.npc.baker_ch03.2: Emergency bread. My oven has never felt so important. It hums now.
dlg.talk.npc.baker_ch03.3: Flour, water, salt, yeast. And now a permit. The permit does not rise.
dlg.talk.npc.bop.1: I am not worried. My LED is flickering for unrelated reasons.
dlg.talk.npc.bop.2: I am a cube, Tí. I do not do hugs. I do diagnostics.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch02.1: The template is from 1998. Your dismissal is from 1998. I am fine. My fan is just loud.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch02.2: You do not exist, I am a cube. Statistically we are the most normal people here.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch03.1: I am logging every side effect today. For science. And, possibly, for you.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch03.2: Rule instability is rising. That is not a warning. It is a weather report.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch03.3: A plaza: where the city gathers to be told it may not gather.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04.1: Why are you looking at me like that? I am a cube. I have no face to read. On purpose.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04.2: Archives make me nervous. Too many things that remember me back.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04_lab.1: I told you. All of it. My LED feels lighter. That is not a technical term.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04_lab.2: You got the truth out of me. I am still calculating whether you forgive me.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04_lab.3: If you ask me about the safe, I will answer with a weather report. Sunny. Evasive.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch04_lab.4: This lab smells like erased paper. I did not erase any paper. Why would you ask.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch05.1: I testified. My LED is steady. Please do not mention it, or it will start flickering.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch05.2: I know this room. I hid in that vent during reset 17. You were very kind to the vent.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_ch05.3: AI witnesses are not legally people. Legally, I am stationery. Expensive stationery.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_counter_ch02.1: I am calm. I am a calm cube. Please stop looking at the archive door like that.
dlg.talk.npc.bop_counter_ch02.2: This building smells of toner and denial. I feel almost at home.
dlg.talk.npc.clerk_ch02.1: Name, number, address. Good. Next you need a photo and proof of life. Tram station.
dlg.talk.npc.clerk_ch02.2: You need a number to reach this window. You need this window to get a number.
dlg.talk.npc.clerk_ch02.3: Address? Addresses only count after something is delivered there. Rules.
dlg.talk.npc.coc.1: You stamped your own dismissal? Irregular. Legal, but irregular.
dlg.talk.npc.coc.2: The Director signed as your witness? He has never signed anything. Suspicious kindness.
dlg.talk.npc.coc.3: Noise was reported in the Silence Corridor. I have written it in three places.
dlg.talk.npc.coc.4: Halt. State your purpose. Then halt again, for the record.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch02.1: You again. Form 12-B. You were polite. Politeness is in your file. Your file is not.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch02.2: You are the man who made me inspect a mirror. I passed. I am still unsettled.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch02.3: I was transferred to queue duty. The queue does not move. Neither does my career.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch03.1: Art may not be sold. Admission may be charged. I have checked twice. It is fine. I hate it.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch03.2: A bread emergency was declared on your street. I have been on alert since breakfast.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch03.3: Delivery trucks on the pedestrian street. Legal, per the sign. I have issued myself a warning.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch03.4: The cart has shoes. Shoes make pedestrians. I did not write the rule. I only obey it.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch03.5: Market inspection in progress. Please be inspected in an orderly manner.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch04.1: Testimony validated. I have filed your absence under "present".
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch04.2: After the bread incident I was reassigned to Witness Security. I guard what people saw.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch05.1: You entered by filing disagreement as compliance. I filed your filing under both. Procedure holds.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch05.2: Director Vượng countersigned a dissent permit? He has never disagreed with anyone. Even himself.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch05.3: You gave me Form 12-B once. I have self-inspected every morning since. I usually pass.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch05.4: Your file is thick. I have read it twice. Irregular, but complete.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_ch05.5: I guard the jurisdiction line. This side: rules. That side: also rules, but further away.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_tram_ch02.1: The Queue Managers' Queue now has a waiting list. I am proud. I am also its first member.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_tram_ch02.2: You. The expired priority ticket. I have recorded your expiry. Twice.
dlg.talk.npc.coc_tram_ch02.3: Transferred again. Tram platform. The transfer form required me to transfer.
dlg.talk.npc.counter_clerk_ch02.1: There are two counter ones now. I was counter one for nine years. I feel replaced.
dlg.talk.npc.counter_clerk_ch02.2: You escalated properly. In writing. You may become my favourite non-person.
dlg.talk.npc.counter_clerk_ch02.3: Your case needs the supervisor. The supervisor is at counter zero. Counter zero is closed.
dlg.talk.npc.crowd_ch02.1: That is the queue manager guy! He invented a queue for the queue! Legend!
dlg.talk.npc.crowd_ch02.2: We have waited since the last reset. Sorry, since Monday. Same thing.
dlg.talk.npc.crowd_ch03.1: Mai feeds this street. If she needs us, we are here. Officially or not.
dlg.talk.npc.crowd_ch03.2: Your tricks keep working, and somehow we keep paying for them. Why should we help?
dlg.talk.npc.crowd_ch03.3: We are not a crowd. We are many individuals standing near each other by coincidence.
dlg.talk.npc.curator_ch04.1: A living exhibit, and I did not catalogue it. My career is a footnote now.
dlg.talk.npc.curator_ch04.2: Please return my key in the condition it was in: unused for forty years.
dlg.talk.npc.curator_ch04.3: Everything here happened officially. Whether it happened is a separate department.
dlg.talk.npc.inspector_ch03.1: Donations, not prices. Very clever. The donation receipts are taxable, of course.
dlg.talk.npc.inspector_ch03.2: Bread tax is simple. The more people you help, the more you owe. Helping is a luxury.
dlg.talk.npc.janitor.1: Thirty-one years, and finally somebody remembered my plaque.
dlg.talk.npc.janitor.2: Elevator? Ha. It only goes up for people who never come down.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch02.1: You wrote yourself into the roster. I keep checking. You are still there. Fascinating.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch02.2: The roster says nobody is standing here. My eyes disagree. I trust neither yet.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04.1: Your two birthdays are on my desk, side by side. They do not get along. Good.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04.2: A third birthday. Very tidy. Tidy is what LOGIC calls it when the evidence leaves.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04.3: I do not believe stories. I believe paper that argues with other paper.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_lab.1: You stamped a perfect file SUSPICIOUS. The stacks are still apologising to each other.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_lab.2: The full log is reconstructed. Now somebody has to read it out loud to LOGIC.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_lab.3: One record is a rumour. Two is an argument. Three independent ones is a history.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_stacks.1: You kept both birthdays. So I will show you the shelf I keep for things that cannot both be true.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_stacks.2: Your third birthday has its own drawer now. It is lonely. Like most reconciliations.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch04_stacks.3: An archive with no errors is like a witness with no doubts. I start checking both.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch05.1: You asked LOGIC by filing your question as an answer? I am writing that down. Twice, for safety.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch05.2: You made LOGIC answer a satisfaction survey? Bold. It gave itself five stars, I assume.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch05.3: His logs and the official record disagree in 2,306 places. I have not been this happy in years.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_ch05.4: Records do not lie, Tí. They disagree, loudly. My job is to listen to both.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_counter_ch02.1: You corrected your own death certificate. In person. I have never filed anything so rude.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_counter_ch02.2: The tax office found you before the Registry did. That tells you who runs this city.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_counter_ch02.3: Counter zero is where the hard questions go. Nobody has seen it open.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_station_ch02.1: I am taking the same tram. Your case is the most interesting error I have filed in years.
dlg.talk.npc.lan_station_ch02.2: Records do not lie. They do, however, disagree with each other quite a lot.
dlg.talk.npc.logic_ch05.1: Thank you for your question. Please do not ask another for one administrative cycle.
dlg.talk.npc.logic_ch05.2: Welcome. Your satisfaction has been pre-recorded. Please enjoy it.
dlg.talk.npc.logic_roof_ch05.1: I am redefining myself. Please hold. Your hold is important to us.
dlg.talk.npc.logic_roof_ch05.2: Only one correct future may be authorized. Please choose it correctly. No pressure. Some pressure.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch03.1: Open again. Now let us make sure it stays open for the people who need it.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch03.2: Every rule has a price, Tí. I just want to know who is paying it.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch03.3: Thirty years of bread, and today it is illegal. Before breakfast, even.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch04.1: Lan says they put you on a plinth with a label. Did they at least dust you first?
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch04.2: The curator lent you his key? He will not lend me a pen to sign for my own flour.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch04.3: It happened. I sold nothing that Thursday. Nobody forgets a day with no sales.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch04.4: I came because Lan asked for witnesses. Vendors remember everything. Especially debts.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch05.1: You saved me with my old kindness receipt. Kindness, filed. My grandmother would laugh.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch05.2: You showed LOGIC it once chose without a rule. So it can choose to keep me. Fair is fair.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_ch05.3: The whole street is on the stairs with thermoses. Say the word and they will testify.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_core_ch05.1: Still here. Still contradictory. Going up to the roof to fetch the street. Bring snacks.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_core_ch05.2: LOGIC queued me for erasure. My stall has two prices, so apparently I am a typo.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_market_ch03.1: The cardboard man is still at my stall. Customers keep asking him for change.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_market_ch03.2: The queue is still there. Some of them are not even buying. They just like belonging.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_market_ch03.3: Every vendor here pays the same nonsense. If we fix it, we fix it for all of us.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_plaza_ch03.1: I am still apologizing for the museum bread. Legal is not the same as decent.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_plaza_ch03.2: The coupons went round the whole market. Old Mrs. Bảy bought rice with bread money.
dlg.talk.npc.mai_plaza_ch03.3: People listen in the plaza. Let us give them something worth hearing.
dlg.talk.npc.mayor_ch03.1: An emergency test about bread. Half the plaza ducked. Very civic of them.
dlg.talk.npc.mayor_ch03.2: I read the lost-item notice myself. I did not know I was reading a protest. Nobody told me.
dlg.talk.npc.mayor_ch03.3: Citizens! Your concerns are important to us. Please hold while we ignore them.
dlg.talk.npc.neighbors_ch03.1: We paid triple. Out of politeness. Politeness is very expensive on this street.
dlg.talk.npc.neighbors_ch03.2: We are a queue now. A queue with opinions. Nobody can stop a queue.
dlg.talk.npc.neighbors_ch03.3: We want bread. We are not allowed to gather to say we want bread.
dlg.talk.npc.tram_inspector_ch02.1: You are the man I fined before he travelled. Best fine of my career. Very proactive.
dlg.talk.npc.tram_inspector_ch02.2: I inspect tickets. Nobody has a ticket. So far, my record is perfect.
dlg.talk.npc.vuong.1: You are still here? Being fired is a full-time job, Tí.
dlg.talk.npc.vuong.2: Please leave efficiently. That was always your problem: efficiency.
dlg.talk.npc.vuong_ch05.1: I countersigned a dissent permit. I disagreed with nothing. I only signed. Is that brave?
dlg.talk.npc.vuong_ch05.2: A committee! I chaired it! Nobody has ever let me chair anything with consequences.
