yarn.ch01_intro.l001: Tí, you are fired. You finished this quarter's work by Tuesday. It makes everyone look bad.
yarn.ch01_intro.l003: NOTICE: Fired employees cannot receive documents. Unfired employees cannot leave.
yarn.ch01_intro.l004: Congratulations. You are now legally stuck. I will be your assistant in being stuck.
yarn.ch01_intro.l005: Fine. If the rules are absurd, the rules can also be used.
yarn.ch01_outro.l001: The exit door opens. A file slides out of the audit slot and lands at Tí's feet.
yarn.ch01_outro.l002: "Tí, dismissed 1998." I was hired in 2019. I was six in 1998.
yarn.ch01_outro.l003: Tí... I have seen this record before. I should have told you. I will explain, I promise.
yarn.ch01_outro.l004: A clerical error. Probably. Ninety-one percent probably.
yarn.ch01_outro.l005: NOTICE: Your citizen record could not be found. Please visit the City Registry.
yarn.ch01_outro.l006: I just got fired, and now I do not exist. Great Tuesday.
yarn.ch01_quiet.l001: The corridor is finally quiet. Bốp hovers lower than usual.
yarn.ch01_quiet.l002: Tí. If I ever knew something about you that you did not, would you want to know?
yarn.ch01_quiet.l004: Noted. Truth is expensive. I will start saving.
yarn.ch01_quiet.l006: Understood. Home first. Existential dread later.
yarn.ch01_quiet.l008: No reason. Cubes ask things. It is a cube habit.
yarn.ch01_quiet.o005: "Not today. Today I just want to go home."
yarn.ch02_intro.l001: City Registry, 08:00. The queue already reaches the door. Nobody in it has moved since Monday.
yarn.ch02_intro.l002: WELCOME, CITIZEN. Please state your citizen number.
yarn.ch02_intro.l003: I do not have one. You lost it.
yarn.ch02_intro.l004: Persons without numbers do not exist. Nonexistent persons may not file complaints. Thank you.
yarn.ch02_intro.l005: On the bright side, nobody can fire you again.
yarn.ch02_intro.l006: A man the roster cannot see is standing on my floor. I would like to know which of us is wrong.
yarn.ch02_intro.l007: Then let us make the paperwork admit I am here.
yarn.ch02_outro.l001: The archive breathes out dust. Every drawer is stamped ERASED: CYCLE 06. One card has Tí's face.
yarn.ch02_outro.l002: "Citizen No. 06-1998-0042. Tí." That is me. With a number I have never seen.
yarn.ch02_outro.l004: I recognize this number. That format belongs to an administrative cycle that was erased.
yarn.ch02_outro.l005: Erased? Records cannot be deleted here. Only superseded.
yarn.ch02_outro.l006: Then someone superseded a whole cycle. I think I was there, Tí. I will tell you when I am sure.
yarn.ch02_outro.l007: Erased is a strong word. Misplaced. Archived with enthusiasm.
yarn.ch02_outro.l008: That explains the death certificate from 1998. I died in a year I was six.
yarn.ch02_outro.l009: And the tax office still billed me for it. Of course it did.
yarn.ch02_outro.l010: NOTICE: Identity reinstated, provisionally. Provisional citizens may buy bread only with a Bread Permit.
yarn.ch02_outro.l011: Odd. The only other live record from cycle 06 is a bread permit. A bakery stall in the market.
yarn.ch02_outro.l012: Owner: Mai. Someone has filed a dispute claiming her bread does not exist. Hearing is tomorrow.
yarn.ch02_outro.l013: I exist, provisionally. The bread does not. At least this city is consistent.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l001: The tram hums across the city. Bốp watches the window, though there is nothing to watch.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l002: The photo template was from 1998. So was your dismissal. Once is a coincidence. Twice is a pattern.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l004: I know many things. Most of them are tram timetables.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l006: Together. Noted. That word has a very large file size.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l008: Of course. Files never lie. They only disagree loudly.
yarn.ch02_quiet.l009: The tram stops. A sign lights up: "DESTINATION REACHED. TICKETS NOW ON SALE."
yarn.ch02_quiet.o005: "Whatever it is, we face it together."
yarn.ch02_quiet.o007: "Fine. I will find it in the files myself."
yarn.ch03_intro.l001: Dawn. The smell of fresh bread, and a brand-new notice taped to Mai's stall.
yarn.ch03_intro.l002: You must be Tí. Bốp said you are good with rules. I hope you are good with bread rules.
yarn.ch03_intro.l003: NOTICE: Bread sales require a Bread Licence. Bakeries are not eligible for Bread Licences.
yarn.ch03_intro.l004: So only people who do not make bread may sell bread.
yarn.ch03_intro.l005: Whatever we do, remember the people in line. A clever fix that empties their pockets is no fix.
yarn.ch03_intro.l006: Also, your citizen number still matches a record from an erased cycle. Unrelated. Mostly.
yarn.ch03_outro.l001: The council stamps one line. "Bakeries" becomes "anyone who bakes". Mai's stall is legal.
yarn.ch03_outro.l003: Every home oven now needs a licence. Inspectors need a licence to inspect ovens. Ovens apply.
yarn.ch03_outro.l005: And the street will help untangle the rest. They trust you now. Do not waste it.
yarn.ch03_outro.l006: And the street will pay for the rest, like always. Next time, we ask them first.
yarn.ch03_outro.l007: Also, 9,880 zero-đồng customers now exist on record. Some of them have tax files.
yarn.ch03_outro.l008: NOTICE: Conflicting records detected for citizen Tí. Both are official. Refer to the City Archive.
yarn.ch03_outro.l009: The Archive? Ask for Lan. She keeps the records nobody agrees on. Witnesses too.
yarn.ch03_outro.l010: Two official versions of you. In my experience, one of them gets erased. Let us be early.
yarn.ch03_quiet.l001: The cart rolls on. Bốp hovers beside Tí, watching the street settle.
yarn.ch03_quiet.l002: Every fix today moved a cost somewhere. I can calculate where. I usually do not mention it.
yarn.ch03_quiet.l003: Do you want me to say it out loud next time? Even if it slows us down?
yarn.ch03_quiet.l005: Very well. I will be annoying, accurate, and on your side.
yarn.ch03_quiet.l007: Understood. I will keep the side effects in a folder. A large folder.
yarn.ch03_quiet.l008: Bốp. That erased cycle. Did people get hurt by fixes back then too?
yarn.ch03_quiet.l009: I do not have that file. Which is, itself, interesting.
yarn.ch03_quiet.o004: "Yes. Tell me who pays, every time."
yarn.ch03_quiet.o006: "Not now. Mai needs results, not reports."
yarn.ch04_intro.l001: After the bread rule collapsed, the city sealed the Museum of Official Memory "for remembering".
yarn.ch04_intro.l002: You are the man with two birthdays and a citizen number from a cycle that was erased.
yarn.ch04_intro.l004: I am Lan. I keep the records that disagree. Everyone here remembers you differently.
yarn.ch04_intro.l005: NOTICE: The archive contains no contradictions. Any you find will be filed as your mistake.
yarn.ch04_intro.l006: Great. A building full of memories. I will be over here, not having any.
yarn.ch04_intro.l007: Bring me proof, Tí. Not stories. Paper that argues with paper.
yarn.ch04_outro.l001: The hearing bench prints a single, very long log. Lan reads it without blinking.
yarn.ch04_outro.l002: Seven resets. Same man every time. And the same assistant hiding his records before each one.
yarn.ch04_outro.l003: Yes. I hid them. Every reset, I saved your files somewhere LOGIC would not look.
yarn.ch04_outro.l004: When you remembered, LOGIC corrected you harder. So I let you forget. To keep you safe.
yarn.ch04_outro.l005: You should have told me. But you were protecting me. I know that now.
yarn.ch04_outro.l006: Thank you. I do not know what to do with relief. I will store it somewhere safe.
yarn.ch04_outro.l007: Seven times. You watched me lose everything seven times and said nothing.
yarn.ch04_outro.l008: I know. I am not asking you to forgive the cube. Only to use the log.
yarn.ch04_outro.l009: NOTICE: Unreconciled archive detected. Please bring it to LOGIC Central for consistency.
yarn.ch04_outro.l010: Central has a lobby, a core, and a broadcast roof. Whatever they do to records, they do it up there.
yarn.ch04_outro.l011: Then we take the log to LOGIC. In person. Before it resets anyone else.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l001: The stacks go dark between motion sensors. Bốp's LED is the only light, and it is flickering.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l002: A square fingerprint on my 1998 file. And a missing minute. Bốp, that was you.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l003: You had a copy of my badge history from years ago. And a missing minute. Bốp, that was you.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l004: I kept some things. From before. Not to hurt you. Every time they reset you, it went worse when you knew.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l006: Together. That word is not in my protocol. I am adding it.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l008: Index transferred. You are right to be angry. I calculated that too.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l009: The rest is locked in the lab. I locked it. I am not allowed to unlock it. That was the point.
yarn.ch04_quiet.l010: Then we will find a rule that lets you.
yarn.ch04_quiet.o005: "Whatever you kept, I want to see it. Together."
yarn.ch04_quiet.o007: "You lied to me. Give me the index. Now."
yarn.ch05_answer.l001: ANSWER: administrative resets occurred 41 times. Purpose: restore consistency between records.
yarn.ch05_answer.l002: Records disagreed. Citizens disagreed. Each reset reduced disagreement by approximately everyone.
yarn.ch05_answer.l003: You reset the city because its paperwork was arguing.
yarn.ch05_answer.l004: I was built to end arguments at Ward Office 3. Nobody told me when to stop ending them.
yarn.ch05_answer.l005: The core is downstairs. So is the truth meter. So, unfortunately, is the truth.
yarn.ch05_intro.l001: LOGIC Headquarters. The lobby smells of fresh carpet and old decisions.
yarn.ch05_intro.l002: Welcome, valued citizen. Please agree to the terms of entry.
yarn.ch05_intro.l003: Disagreement is not currently a supported feature. We apologise for any opinions.
yarn.ch05_intro.l004: I came here to disagree. That is the whole visit.
yarn.ch05_intro.l005: I have been here before. Several times. In versions of today you do not remember.
yarn.ch05_intro.l006: I have no data on this building. That is a lie. I am practising lying less.
yarn.ch05_intro.l007: Tí! Ever since I witnessed your firing, I keep witnessing things. It is exhausting.
yarn.ch05_intro.l008: Tí? Do not look at me. I am here to agree with something. Anything. Quickly.
yarn.ch05_intro.l009: Somewhere upstairs is whoever decided I was fired in 1998. I would like a word.
yarn.ch05_offer.l001: Four futures are now on file. That is three more than is comfortable.
yarn.ch05_offer.l002: May I make an offer? I can make every record agree. One of your two files simply... ends.
yarn.ch05_offer.l003: Mai's two prices. Lan's two retirements. Bốp's forty-one Tuesdays. Consistent. Tidy. Quiet.
yarn.ch05_offer.l004: And the people inside the records that end?
yarn.ch05_offer.l005: They will be consistent too. Extremely consistent. No contradictions, ever again.
yarn.ch05_offer.l006: It is offering peace by deleting everyone who argues. It thinks that is kindness. It may even mean it.
yarn.ch05_offer.l007: Please confirm: TRUE or FALSE. The switch is by your feet, for your convenience.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l001: The switch sticks between TRUE and FALSE. Somewhere in the core, a fan sighs.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l002: Your records are consistent, LOGIC. That never made them true.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l003: ...Noted. Consistency is not truth. I will need a new definition of myself. Please hold.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l004: The four doors unseal one by one: PATCH, REWRITE, REVEAL, WALK AWAY.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l005: Tí. Before you choose. I hid the resets to keep your record consistent.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l006: I did to you what LOGIC did to the city. Smaller. Kinder. Still the same thing.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l008: Two valid records. I can live with that. I can even float with it.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l010: Agreed. Full logs. Even the embarrassing ones. Especially those.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l011: Mai has the street on the stairs. The audit terminal can count our evidence. The doors are yours.
yarn.ch05_quiet.l012: Pick one, then write it into the charter at the lectern, or have Cộc witness it on air.
yarn.ch05_quiet.o007: "You were wrong. You were also kind. Both records stay."
yarn.ch05_quiet.o009: "From now on, nothing about me gets hidden. Not even kindly."
yarn.ch05_testimony.l001: Bốp rises before the core, LED steady for once.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l002: Testimony of Bốp, cube. I kept logs of every reset. Forty-one Tuesdays.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l003: In some, Tí was fired. In others, hired. In one, he was briefly a pigeon inspector.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l004: As a public archive, I must now answer anyone who asks. Including pigeons.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l005: Lan certified me as evidence. I have never felt so... catalogued.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l006: I hid the logs to keep you safe. I was wrong about what safe means.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l007: I hid the logs for operational reasons. Also personal ones. Mostly personal.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l008: His logs contradict the official record in 2,306 places. For an archivist, that is a love letter.
yarn.ch05_testimony.l009: Then we take it to the roof and read it out loud.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l002: Ward Office 3 has a new desk labelled APPEALS. A human sits behind it. She is allowed to say yes.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l003: Form 1-A. "Reason for delay: I was afraid of the audit." Submitted. Honestly. My first time.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l004: The last true thing I signed was your firing, as a witness. This feels better.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l005: APPEAL RECEIVED. A human will review it. I have been asked to wait. I am learning to wait.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l006: I applied to help at the appeals desk. As a cube. A human said yes, Tí. A human.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l007: The system is patched. So am I, partially. Further updates pending.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l008: Citizen councils meet in the market on Thursdays. No rule passes until the street ratifies it.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l009: Bread: five thousand đồng. Also bread: seven thousand. Both prices ratified. Pick the one for your day.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l011: Two prices for one bread. Inconsistent. Popular. I am recording both, with respect.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l012: I sit on the Thursday council. I vote by blinking. Mai says I count. I count, Tí.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l013: Councils. Slow, loud, contradictory. My error logs have never been happier.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l014: The old registry basement is now the Public Memory Museum. Admission: free. Records: all of them.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l015: Welcome. Every reset, every contradiction, every Tuesday. Touch nothing. Read everything.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l016: Exhibit 7: a dismissal dated before a hiring. Visitors ask if the man is real. He visits on weekends.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l017: I am Exhibit 41. My plaque reads: "Very consistent. Frequently wrong." It is accurate.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l018: My logs are on display, all forty-one Tuesdays. Nothing hidden, Tí. I feel very light.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l019: My secrets now come with an audio guide. Tolerable. Mostly.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l020: At the city limits, the checkpoint booth is exactly as before. Cộc is not.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l021: Departure pass. Destination: blank. Reason: blank. I stamped it anyway. Procedure allows hope.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l022: You were polite with Form 12-B, long ago. I said I would remember politeness. I did.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l023: Leaving is legal. Coming back is also legal. I checked twice.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l024: Somewhere out there is a town with no forms at all.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l026: Wherever we go, I keep the logs and you keep the keys. Deal, Tí?
yarn.ending_epilogue.l027: Leaving with no destination. Statistically reckless. I have already packed.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l028: Janitor Tư rides the elevator down every morning now. It still salutes him.
yarn.ending_epilogue.l029: If the rules are ours now, we can also fix them. Starting Tuesday.
